caption: The only rule longer than two symbols splits at its first symbol: S keeps NP and hands VP PP to a new helper nonterminal X1, kept in the original order. The grammar goes from 10 rules to 11 and generates exactly the same sentences.

spec.title: S → NP VP PP becomes two binary rules
spec.aria: One rule of three symbols, S → NP VP PP, out of a 10-rule grammar, splits into S → NP X1 and X1 → VP PP using one new nonterminal X1, giving an 11-rule grammar with the same sentences.
